description: Returns the host average and max CPU over the last 15 minutes. Values are fractions: 0.9 means 90%. Use it to check whether the host in a CPU alert is actually at or above 90%. Parameter host is the exact host.name.

configuration.query: FROM metrics-system.cpu-* | WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - 15 minutes AND host.name == ?host | STATS avg_cpu = AVG(system.cpu.total.norm.pct), max_cpu = MAX(system.cpu.total.norm.pct), samples = COUNT(*) BY host.name | LIMIT 5

host.description: Exact host.name of the machine from the alert
